purpose: Define deactivation of an identity as a lifecycle state that preserves historical PortfolioCore/MeritCore/project evidence and provenance while preventing new governed activity according to policy.

topics.name: Identity Deactivation and History
topics.purpose: Define deactivation of an identity as a lifecycle state that preserves historical PortfolioCore/MeritCore/project evidence and provenance while preventing new governed activity according to policy.

semantics.deactivation_rule: Deactivation changes lifecycle status; it does not delete or merge identity history.
semantics.history_rule: Existing PortfolioCore, MeritCore and Project evidence retains its original identity refs.
semantics.credential_rule: Deactivation revokes/disables applicable credentials/sessions according to IAM policy.
semantics.authorization_rule: Deactivated identity cannot perform new governed activity unless an explicit reactivation policy permits it.
semantics.reactivation_rule: If supported, reactivation restores the same semantic identity rather than creating a merged/new identity.
semantics.privacy_rule: Historical visibility is controlled by explicit policy and may differ from activity rights.

invariants.rule: Identity lifecycle, authentication assurance, credential state and session state remain explicit and cannot be inferred from authorization, transport or profile data.

hard_gates.condition: deactivated identity merged into another identity
credentials remain usable without explicit policy
reactivation creates a silently merged identity
historical visibility inferred from activity rights

references.purpose: Lifecycle state belongs to stable identity.

prose.summary: Define deactivation of an identity as a lifecycle state that preserves historical PortfolioCore/MeritCore/project evidence and provenance while preventing new governed activity according to policy.
